name: DoubleJump
description: Lets any player perform a mid-air double jump by pressing the swap-hands key (F) while airborne.
usage: Jump off a ledge, then press F (swap hands) while falling to rocket upward again
manual: Every player can now double jump: jump normally off the ground, and while you're still airborne press the swap-hands key (F by default) to get a second boost of momentum in the direction you're looking. Landing on solid ground resets your double jump so you can use it again next time you're airborne. The vertical-boost setting controls how much upward velocity the double jump gives (default 0.9, from 0.3 to 2.0), and horizontal-boost controls how much forward momentum is added based on where you're looking (default 0.6, from 0 to 3.0). The effects-enabled toggle (default on) controls whether a puff of cloud particles and a takeoff sound play when you double jump. Note that pressing F still swaps your main-hand and off-hand items as usual, since that's the same key used to trigger the double jump.
